current.for: Close of Wednesday 25-Nov-2026 (15:15–15:30) and the 01-Dec carry (weekly expiry 01-Dec)
current.stance: Changed: 25,700–26,000, lean up; the 25,800 cap is being unwound, buy a dip holding 25,700, no shorts under 26,000.
lines: Changed: the lean flips up. Nifty reads 25,791, 9 under the 25,800 cap, and call writers covered 100K contracts in the hour; 25,800 CE fell to 99K from 107K. Call 48 closes wrong; call 49 opens.
Ceiling (01-Dec): 25,800 CE 99K cut 8K; 26,000 CE 150K cut 14K; 25,900 CE 68K cut 8K. 26,500 CE 130K (+52K) is the only far wall still growing. The cap is thinning, not building.
Floor: 25,800 PE 72K (+47K) and 25,750 PE 37K (+34K) are fresh put writing at spot; 25,700 PE 81K cut 11K. 25,500 PE 97K (+40K) is the wall below. Max pain 25,700 unchanged.
Flows: 01-Dec PCR 0.87 from 0.83, near-spot 0.80 from 0.74. Calls added today fell to 348K from 447K; puts 565K steady. The hour was call covering. 08-Dec PCR 0.95, max pain 25,700.
Pricing: 25,800 straddle 443 implies ±376 by Tuesday; ATM IV 17.4 call vs 16.3 put, both down from 18.8/16.1. VIX 17.73, up 0.2%. No futures print.
Carry: the 01-Dec 25,700/25,500 bull put spread pays ≈67 (161−95) for 133 of risk, breakeven 25,633, sold strike on the 81K put wall at max pain. Up 442 on the day; the 25,350 gap stays open.

glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.
